title: Failure Recovery Chooser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agents for Robotics
description: Choose the best next action for an agent in eight situations where something has gone wrong. The four actions are retry once, replan, ask a human and stop the arm. Used in Chapter 16.

educational.topic: Replanning, failed grasp recovery, asking a human and the stop tool
learningObjectives: Recommend the best next action for each of eight situations an agent meets, choosing among retry once, replan, ask a human and stop the arm, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Weigh four courses of action against each situation, with the best action and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Is this a first failure or a repeated one?
Does the error message say how to fix the plan?
Could a guess move the wrong object?
commonMisconceptions: The agent should keep retrying until it works
Ambiguity should be settled by a best guess
A stopped arm can be restarted by the agent
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed recommendations; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Start / Check / Next situation / See score / Try again
